about: Cboe Global Markets is an options, equities, futures and FX exchange operator, with HQ moved to Chicago (input shows Lenexa, Kansas, a major US equities site). It operates Cboe Options Exchange, the VIX volatility index, the Cboe BZX equity exchanges and Cboe Europe. Listed on Cboe itself (CBOE), with annual revenue of around $4 billion. B2B financial brand, well known in markets, with little mainstream consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Cboe Global Markets
wiki.text: Cboe Global Markets, Inc. (formerly CBOE Holdings and Chicago Board Options Exchange) is an American financial exchange operator. In the U.S., it owns the largest exchange for trading in options, where it has a 30% market share, and the third-largest exchange for trading in equities (after the New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq), where it has a 10% market share. It operates the largest stock exchange in Europe, where it has a 25% market share. It is headquartered in Chicago, where it maintains an open outcry trading floor. The company offers trading in options on both stock market indexes and individual stocks (52% of 2025 revenues), Nort

about: Alight Solutions is a US cloud-based human capital and benefits administration company, headquartered in the Chicago area (Lincolnshire, Illinois), serving employers with benefits, payroll, health and wellbeing, and retirement services. It supports millions of employees at large corporate clients and is listed on the NYSE (ALIT). Founded as part of Aon Hewitt. B2B with little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Alight
wiki.text: Alight, formerly the American Refugee Committee (ARC), is an international nonprofit, nonsectarian organization that provides humanitarian assistance and training to refugees. Alight works with its partners and constituencies to provide opportunities and expertise to communities of refugees and internally displaced persons in seven countries in Africa, Asia, and Europe, including Iraq, Kosovo, Haiti and in the Darfur region of Sudan. Alight provides shelter, clean water and sanitation, health care, skills training, microcredit education, and protection to help survivors of war and natural disasters to rebuild their lives and promote human dig

wiki.title: Alight Solutions
wiki.what: Information Technology and consulting company based in Chicago, Illinois
wiki.text: Alight Solutions is an American information technology and consulting company that provides cloud-based systems, outsourcing and consultancy related to human resource. They provide platforms and outsourcing for large companies to manage their human capital this includes health benefit administration, financial management and retirement planning. The company is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. The company went public on July 6, 2021, trading in the New York Stock Exchange under ALIT.

about: Egis is a French engineering, consulting and project operation group, based in Saint-Quentin-en-Yvelines, working on roads, rail, airports, urban transport, water and buildings in more than 100 countries. It also operates airports and toll roads through concessions and runs mobility services. Revenue is around EUR 1.5-2 billion with about 19,000 employees. Shareholders include Caisse des Depots and employees. B2B infrastructure group with strong profile in public works circles.

China International Marine Containers (CIMC) is a Chinese manufacturer, based in Shenzhen, that is the world's largest maker of dry cargo containers and a major supplier of road transport vehicles, logistics and energy equipment, with offshore engineering. Customers are shipping lines, logistics groups and energy companies in over 100 countries. Revenue is around RMB 150 billion. Listed on the Shenzhen and Hong Kong stock exchanges (000039, 2039). B2B industrial brand, with no consumer awareness.

wiki.title: China International Marine Containers
wiki.text: China International Marine Containers (Group) Co., Ltd (CIMC; Chinese: 中集集团) is a Chinese company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of transportation equipment, such as containers, road transport vehicles and airport ground-handling equipment. China International Marine Containers was a constituent of SZSE 100 Index, but was removed in January 2017. As of 4 July 2017, it is one of the 200 components of SZSE 200 Index (the mid cap index of 101st to 300th companies).

about: Assurant is a global provider of lifestyle and housing protection, based in Atlanta, Georgia and listed on the NYSE (AIZ). It sells extended warranties and device protection through partners such as mobile carriers and retailers, renters and lender-placed insurance, and vehicle service contracts, with revenue near US$11 billion. Customers are partners such as Apple, AT&T and Verizon and end consumers. Funding of about $469M was recorded in 2025. Strong B2B2C brand, but consumers often know it only through carrier insurance programmes.

wiki.title: Assurant
wiki.text: Assurant, Inc. is a global provider of risk management products and services with headquarters in Atlanta. Its businesses provide a diverse set of speciality, niche-market insurance products in the property, casualty, extended device protection, and insurance sectors. The company's main operating segments are Global Housing and Global Lifestyle. The company, formerly known as Fortis, Inc., was spun off from Dutch and Belgian financial-services company Fortis Insurance N.V. in 2004. The company's initial public offering on Feb. 5, 2004 at $1.76 billion was the fourth largest that year. In connection with the public offering, the company change

about: India's second-largest IT services company, a Bengaluru-based consulting, digital transformation, cloud and outsourcing group with about 320,000 employees and annual revenue of roughly 19 billion dollars. Clients are large banks, insurers, manufacturers, retailers and governments across North America and Europe. It also sells Finacle banking software and Topaz AI services. Founded in 1981 and listed on the NSE, BSE and NYSE (INFY). Strong B2B brand and a known sponsor of tennis and cricket.
flags: last funding 2008: check it is still independent and operating

wiki.title: Infosys
wiki.what: Indian multinational technology company founded in 1981
wiki.text: Infosys Limited is an Indian multinational technology company that offers information technology, business consulting, and outsourcing services. Founded in 1981 by seven engineers, the company is headquartered in Bengaluru and considered one of the Big Six Indian IT companies. Infosys has also attracted controversies due to allegations of visa and tax fraud in the United States and for creating malfunctioning government websites.

about: GEMS Education is a Dubai-founded operator of private K-12 schools, started by the Varkey family, running dozens of schools in the UAE and further afield, with several hundred thousand students and international curricula. Crunchbase gives a London address. Revenue is from tuition fees, and funding of about $3.4 billion is shown, which should be verified. Known mainly in the Gulf and among expatriate parent communities, with moderate consumer awareness.
cb_desc: GEMS Education is a network of private schools and education...

wiki.title: GEMS Education
wiki.text: GEMS Education, founded as Global Education Management Systems (GEMS), is an international education company. It is one of the world's largest private school operators, and as of late 2022 it operates more than 60 schools across the Middle East and North Africa, and also has schools in Asia, Europe, and North America. Founded in Dubai by Sunny Varkey, the firm provides pre-school, primary, and secondary education.

about: Inspired Education Group is a global premium private schools operator, with more than 100 schools in about 30 countries across Europe, Africa, the Americas, Asia and Australia, serving tens of thousands of students from kindergarten through university. Founded in 2013 by Nadim Nsouli, it is privately owned by Brookfield-related and other investors, and its head office is in London while this record shows Sydney. Revenue is from tuition. Known to affluent parents, with moderate consumer awareness.
cb_desc: Inspired Education delivers online education services and...

about: Singapore-headquartered executive education platform partnering with top universities (Harvard, MIT, Wharton), offering online programs for professionals. Founded in 2010 in India by Ashwin Damera and Chaitanya Kalipatnapu, it merged with Emeritus and sells courses to individuals and companies globally. Venture-funded and valued in the billions of dollars at its peak. B2B and consumer education brand.

Sodexo is a French multinational food services and facilities management company, headquartered at Issy-les-Moulineaux near Paris, listed on Euronext Paris (SW). It runs catering, cleaning and on-site services for corporate, education, healthcare, government and sports and leisure clients, plus employee benefit vouchers (Pluxee, spun off in 2024). It employs about 420,000 people in around 45 countries, with revenue of roughly 23 billion euros. Already a major hospitality supplier at sporting venues; a B2B brand with some public recognition.

wiki.title: Sodexo
wiki.what: French food services and facilities management company
wiki.text: Sodexo (formerly Sodexho Alliance) is a French food services and facilities management company headquartered in the Paris suburb of Issy-les-Moulineaux. It has 426,464 employees as of 2025, operates in 43 countries and serves 80 million customers on a daily basis on 27,000 sites. It is Europe’s second largest company of its type by both number of employees and revenue after Compass Group and France’s second largest private employer worldwide. For fiscal year 2023 (ending August 2023), revenues reached €28.1 billion with an underlying operating profit of 699 million euro. Market capitalization was 11.5 billion euros as at 26 October 2023. Sode

about: News Corp is a global media and information services company based in New York, controlled by the Murdoch family and listed on Nasdaq (NWSA, NWS). Its holdings include Dow Jones (The Wall Street Journal, Barron's), HarperCollins, News UK (The Times, The Sun), News Corp Australia, REA Group and Foxtel/Fox Sports in Australia. Revenue is about $10 billion a year. Highly recognisable media group with large audiences, open to advertising and sports partnerships.

wiki.title: News Corp
wiki.text: News Corporation, doing business as News Corp, is an American mass media and publishing company headquartered at 1211 Avenue of the Americas in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. The company was formed on June 28, 2013, as a spin-off of the first News Corporation, whose legal successor was 21st Century Fox, which held its media and entertainment assets. Operating across digital real estate information, news media, book publishing, and cable television, News Corp's notable assets include: Dow Jones & Company, which is the publisher of The Wall Street Journal; News UK, publisher of The Sun and The Times; News Corp Australia; REA Group, operator

about: Grupo Bancolombia is Colombia's largest financial group, based in Medellin, offering retail, corporate and investment banking, insurance, wealth management and digital wallets such as Nequi, and with operations in Colombia, Central America including Banistmo in Panama, and other countries. It has millions of customers, tens of thousands of employees and assets in the tens of billions of dollars, and is listed on the Colombian exchange and the NYSE as CIB. A very visible consumer bank in Colombia, historically a sponsor of football and cultural events there.

wiki.title: Bancolombia
wiki.text: Bancolombia S.A. (formerly: Banco de Colombia) is a full-service financial institution that provides financial products and services in Colombia, Panama and Puerto Rico. Bancolombia is one of the six banking-related companies of the COLCAP index. The Bank operates in nine segments: Banking Colombia, Banking El Salvador, Leasing, Trust, Investment, Brokerage, Off Shore and Insurance, and all other segments. As of December 31, 2023, the Bank's consolidated branch network consisted of 938 offices. As of December 31, 2025, the bank had 16,297,225 customers.

about: World's most downloaded language-learning app, offering gamified lessons in over 40 languages, plus maths, music and chess courses, with Duolingo English Test as a certified exam. Revenue comes from subscriptions (Super and Max), ads and test fees, roughly 750 million dollars in 2024, with over 100 million monthly active users. Founded in 2011 by Luis von Ahn and Severin Hacker, and listed on Nasdaq (DUOL) since 2021. Strong consumer brand with its green owl mascot and viral social media marketing.

wiki.title: Duolingo
wiki.text: Duolingo, Inc. is an American educational technology company that produces learning apps and provides language certification. Duolingo offers courses on 42 languages, ranging from English, French, and Spanish to less commonly studied languages such as Hawaiian, Scottish Gaelic, and Navajo, and even constructed languages such as Esperanto, Klingon and High Valyrian It also offers courses on music, math, and chess. The learning method incorporates gamification to motivate users with points, rewards and interactive lessons featuring spaced repetition. The app promotes short, daily lessons for consistent, phased practice. Duolingo also offers the

about: Kobalt is a music publishing and rights administration company, founded in 2000 by Willard Ahdritz, and now based in New York and London, that collects royalties for songwriters, artists and independent publishers through AWAL and Kobalt Music. It works with writers such as Paul McCartney, and Lorde, and has been valued around $1 billion or more. Customers are artists and labels. Music-industry brand with lower consumer profile.

Akamai is a US cloud and cybersecurity company, based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, whose content delivery network and edge platform delivers and secures traffic for most of the world's large websites and streamers, plus a growing cloud computing arm through Linode. Revenue is about $4 billion. Listed on Nasdaq (AKAM). Customers are enterprises. B2B with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Akamai Technologies
wiki.text: Akamai Technologies, Inc. is an American company specializing in content delivery network (CDN), cybersecurity, DDoS mitigation, and cloud services. It is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

about: Live Nation Entertainment is the world's largest live entertainment company, based in Beverly Hills, California, combining concert promotion, the Ticketmaster ticketing platform, venues (House of Blues) and artist management with sponsorship sales. It sells hundreds of millions of tickets across 40-plus countries and has revenue of about $23 billion. Listed on the NYSE (LYV). Facing a US antitrust case. Very high consumer brand visibility.

wiki.title: Live Nation Entertainment
wiki.text: Live Nation Entertainment, Inc. is an American multinational entertainment company that was founded in 2010 following the merger of Live Nation and Ticketmaster. It continues to operate both brands as subsidiary companies, promoting and managing ticket sales for live entertainment internationally. It also owns and operates entertainment venues and festivals and manages the careers of music artists. The company has faced widespread criticism over its central role in the consolidation of the live events industry, allegations of anti-competitive practices, poor handling of the ticket sale process for highly popular events, and injuries and death

about: ADP (Automatic Data Processing) is a Roseland, New Jersey provider of cloud human capital management software and outsourcing: payroll, HR, benefits, time and talent tools, plus PEO services. Customers are around 1 million businesses worldwide, from small firms to large multinationals, and it processes pay for tens of millions of workers; revenue is about 20 billion dollars a year, mostly recurring. Founded in 1949, it trades on Nasdaq (ADP). ADP is a well-known B2B brand and has been a major motorsport sponsor, including NASCAR and IndyCar team deals.

wiki.title: ADP (company)
wiki.text: Automatic Data Processing, Inc. (ADP) is an American multinational provider of cloud-based human resources management, payroll processing, and professional employer organization (PEO) services, headquartered in Roseland, New Jersey.

about: Fosun International is a Shanghai conglomerate with businesses in health, insurance and asset management, tourism and leisure (a stake in Club Med), and property development, and it has owned Wolves football club and Cirque du Soleil stakes. Founded in 1992 by Guo Guangchang, it is listed in Hong Kong (656) and has total assets in the hundreds of billions of dollars. Group with a large public profile in China and links to European sport and leisure.

wiki.title: Fosun International
wiki.text: Fosun International Limited is a Chinese multinational conglomerate holding company. Founded in 1992 by Guo Guangchang and four others, the company is headquartered in Shanghai and was incorporated in Hong Kong in 2004. Its Co-CEOs are Chen Qiyu and Xu Xiaoliang. Wang Qunbin joined Guo Guangchang as co-chairman in early 2020. The company has operations in over 35 countries and is one of the largest privately owned conglomerates in China. It was ranked 371st on the Forbes Global 2000 ranking in 2020.

about: Magic Leap is a Plantation, Florida developer of augmented reality headsets, including the Magic Leap 2 headset for enterprise and healthcare, built with optics and waveguide technology. Customers are enterprises, hospitals and the military. Founded in 2010, it raised more than 4 billion dollars with backers such as Google and Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, and pivoted from consumers to enterprise in 2020. Partnership with Google on AR was announced in 2024. Known in tech circles but with limited consumer sales.

wiki.title: Magic Leap
wiki.text: Magic Leap, Inc. is an American technology company that makes augmented reality headsets and software. Its first product was a head-mounted augmented reality display, called Magic Leap One, which superimposes 3D computer-generated imagery over real world objects. It is attempting to construct a light-field chip using silicon photonics. The company has since released the Magic Leap 2 and stopped selling the Magic Leap 1. Magic Leap was founded by Rony Abovitz in 2010 and has raised $2.6 billion from a list of investors including Google and Alibaba Group. Ross Rosenberg became CEO in 2023.

about: Mediobanca is a Milan investment bank, founded in 1946, offering corporate and investment banking, wealth management (Mediobanca Private Banking), and consumer credit via Compass, with a historic stake in Assicurazioni Generali. It is listed on Borsa Italiana (MB). In 2025 it was the target of an offer from Monte dei Paschi di Siena, which won control. Well known in Italian finance but mostly a B2B bank.

wiki.title: Mediobanca
wiki.text: Mediobanca S.p.A. is an Italian investment bank founded in 1946 at the initiative of Raffaele Mattioli (at that time CEO of Banca Commerciale Italiana) and Enrico Cuccia to facilitate the post-World War II reconstruction of Italian industry. Cuccia led Mediobanca from 1946 to 1982. Today, it is an international banking group with offices in Milan, Frankfurt, London, Madrid, Luxembourg, New York and Paris. As of today, Mediobanca Group is a diversified banking group consisting of four business divisions: Wealth Management, Corporate & Investment Banking, Consumer Finance and Insurance. The Wealth Management area, whose launch in 2016 reshaped

about: Strabag is a Vienna-based construction group, with the input listing Spittal an der Drau in Austria, active in building construction, civil engineering, transport infrastructure and property services in Europe and beyond. It employs about 80,000 staff and has revenue around 17 billion euros. It is listed on the Vienna Stock Exchange (STR), with Rasperia (linked to Oleg Deripaska) and Haselsteiner families as owners. A B2B contractor with sports ties to football in Austria.

wiki.title: Strabag
wiki.text: Strabag is an Austrian international technology group for the built environment based in Spittal an der Drau, Austria, with its headquarters in Vienna. It is the largest construction company in Austria and one of the largest construction companies in Europe. The company is active in its home markets Austria and Germany and in all countries of Central, Eastern and South-Eastern Europe, in selected markets in Western Europe, on the Arabian Peninsula, as well as in Australia, Canada, Chile, China, India and Africa. In these markets Strabag has subsidiaries or operates on a project-basis.

about: Accenture is a global professional services company, headquartered in Dublin, Ireland and listed on the NYSE (ACN), offering consulting, technology, operations and AI services to large corporations and governments in over 120 countries. It has around 770,000 employees and annual revenue of about $65-70 billion, and earns income from project fees and long-term outsourcing contracts. Well known in business circles and a sponsor in sports such as golf, with strong brand awareness among executives.

wiki.title: Accenture
wiki.text: Accenture plc is a technology consulting company headquartered in Dublin, Ireland. Founded in 1989 in the United States, Accenture provides information technology and management consulting services across 120 countries globally.

about: Norsk Hydro is an Oslo-headquartered aluminium and renewable energy company, listed on Oslo Børs (NHY), in which the Norwegian state holds about 34 percent. It runs bauxite mining, alumina refining, primary aluminium smelters, rolling and extrusion (including the Sapa business bought in 2017), recycling and hydropower, with around 32,000 employees in 40 countries. Revenue is about 200 billion Norwegian kronor. Customers are car makers, builders and packaging firms. Strong Nordic corporate brand, with limited direct consumer exposure.

wiki.title: Norsk Hydro
wiki.what: Norwegian aluminium and renewable energy company
wiki.text: Norsk Hydro ASA (often referred to as just Hydro) is a Norwegian aluminium and renewable energy company, headquartered in Oslo. It is one of the largest aluminium companies worldwide. It has operations in some 50 countries around the world and is active on all continents. The Norwegian state owns 34.3% of the company through the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Fisheries. A further 6.5% is owned by Folketrygdfond, which administers the Government Pension Fund of Norway. Norsk Hydro employs approximately 35,000 people. Eivind Kallevik has been the CEO since May, 2024, following Hilde Merete Aasheim. Rune Bjerke has been the Chairman since 2024

about: Marvell Technology is a Santa Clara, California fabless semiconductor company, listed on Nasdaq as MRVL, that designs chips for data infrastructure, including custom AI accelerators, electro-optics, Ethernet switching, storage controllers and automotive networking. Its customers are cloud providers such as Amazon, Microsoft and Google, telecom equipment makers and automakers. Revenue is around $6-7 billion. It was founded in 1995. B2B chipmaker widely known in technology and investment circles, with almost no consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Marvell Technology
wiki.text: Marvell Technology, Inc. is an American company, headquartered in Santa Clara, California, which develops and produces semiconductors and related technology. Founded in 1995, the company had close to 7,500 employees as of 2026, with over 10,000 patents worldwide, and an annual revenue of $8.2 billion for fiscal 2026.

about: Cenovus Energy is a Calgary-based integrated oil and gas company listed on the TSX and NYSE (CVE), operating oil sands, heavy oil, refining, and gas operations, and the Husky Energy business it acquired in 2021, plus MEG Energy acquired in 2025. It produces roughly 800,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day and has Husky and Mohawk retail brands in Canada. Well known in Canada and a sponsor of local sports.

wiki.title: Cenovus Energy
wiki.what: Canadian integrated oil and natural gas company
wiki.text: Cenovus Energy Inc. (pronounced se-nō-vus) is a Canadian integrated oil and natural gas company headquartered in Calgary, Alberta. Its offices are located at Brookfield Place, having completed a move from the neighbouring Bow in 2019.

about: Lightspeed Commerce is a Montreal cloud commerce software company that offers a unified point-of-sale, payments and e-commerce platform to retailers, restaurants and golf courses, serving about 160,000 customer locations in over 100 countries. Founded in 2005 and listed on the NYSE and TSX (LSPD). It earns subscription and payments revenue of roughly $1 billion. B2B software brand with known profile in hospitality and retail.

wiki.title: Lightspeed Commerce
wiki.text: Lightspeed Commerce is a point-of-sale and e-commerce software provider based in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. It was founded in 2005 by Dax da Silva, who was its CEO until February 2022. It has offices in Montreal, New York, Ottawa, Toronto, London, Belfast, Amsterdam, Berlin, Geneva, Ghent, Melbourne, Ulyanovsk, Yerevan and Tbilisi. It offers its services to retail, restaurant, and hospitality businesses.

about: IM8 is a Charlotte, North Carolina nutritional supplements brand co-founded with David Beckham, offering science-backed daily nutrition products such as its Daily Ultimate Essentials drink mix. Launched in 2023, it is owned by Prenetics, the Nasdaq-listed health firm, and sold direct to consumers online and in some retail. Beckham is the brand's face and an investor. Rapidly growing consumer brand with a celebrity link, a natural fit for sports sponsorship.

Xylem is a global water technology company, headquartered in Washington, D.C., making pumps, meters, treatment and analytics systems for utilities, industry and buildings, under brands including Flygt, Sensus, Evoqua and Xylem Vue. Spun off from ITT in 2011, it has revenue of about $8.6 billion and operates in over 150 countries. Listed on the NYSE (XYL). B2B, with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Xylem
wiki.what: Water transport tissue in vascular plants
wiki.text: Xylem is one of the two types of transport tissue in vascular plants, the other being phloem; both of these are part of the vascular bundle. The basic function of the xylem is to transport water upward from the roots to parts of the plants such as stems and leaves, but it also transports nutrients.

about: Sonangol E.P. is Angola's state-owned national oil company, headquartered in Luanda. It holds concession rights over the country's oil and gas, manages exploration and production partnerships with international majors, and has downstream interests in refining, fuel distribution, shipping and trading, plus a banking and real estate legacy now being restructured. Revenue comes from crude sales and royalties. It is wholly owned by the Angolan state. Very well known in Angola, with a national sponsorship profile in sport and culture.

wiki.title: Sonangol Group
wiki.text: Group Sonangol (Portuguese: Grupo Sonangol) is a parastatal that formerly oversaw petroleum and natural gas production in Angola. The group consisted of Sonangol E.P. (Portuguese: Sociedade Nacional de Combustíveis de Angola, E.P.) and its many subsidiaries. The subsidiaries generally had Sonangol E.P. as a primary client, along with other corporate, commercial, and individual clients. In 2023, Sonangol produced 202,000 barrels of oil with an income of US$ 10.9 billion.

about: OpenAI is a San Francisco artificial intelligence company, founded in 2015, that develops large language and multimodal models and the ChatGPT consumer app, plus the API, Codex and Sora products, sold to developers, enterprises and hundreds of millions of weekly users. Revenue comes from subscriptions, API use and enterprise licences, in the billions of dollars. Microsoft is its largest investor, and the company has raised well over 100 billion dollars. Very high consumer brand awareness, among the most recognised technology names worldwide.

wiki.title: OpenAI
wiki.text: OpenAI Group PBC is an American artificial intelligence (AI) public benefit corporation (PBC) headquartered in San Francisco, California. It develops "frontier" generative AI models, particularly its generative pre-trained transformer (GPT) series of large language models. Its release of ChatGPT in November 2022 accelerated an AI boom, leading to widespread use of generative AI; as of September 2026, ChatGPT is the fifth-most-visited website globally. OpenAI also releases the GPT Image models and Codex, an AI coding agent. In March 2026, OpenAI closed a funding round with a post-money valuation of US$852 billion, making it one of the most val

about: Boldyn Networks is a London-based neutral host network infrastructure company, formerly BAI Communications, which builds and runs shared 5G, in-building and small cell wireless, WiFi and fibre networks for transport systems, stadiums, universities, venues and cities. Customers include mobile operators and transit agencies, such as the New York City Subway and the London Underground. Funding is about 1.2 billion dollars. B2B infrastructure brand with little consumer awareness, though its networks serve large venues and stadiums.

wiki.title: BAI Communications
wiki.text: BAI Communications, formerly Broadcast Australia, is an Australian telecommunications systems company.

about: Franklin Resources is a global asset manager based in San Mateo, California, operating as Franklin Templeton, with brands including Templeton, Legg Mason affiliates (acquired 2020), Clarion Partners, Martin Currie and Western Asset. It manages about $1.5-1.6 trillion for retail investors, institutions and sovereign funds in more than 150 countries and employs about 9,000 people. Revenue comes from management fees. Listed on the NYSE as BEN, with the Johnson family as major shareholders. Well known in finance and active in sports and events marketing.

wiki.title: Franklin Templeton
wiki.text: Franklin Templeton, Inc. is an American multinational investment management holding company that, together with its subsidiaries, is referred to as Franklin Templeton. It is a global investment firm with operations in over 150 countries. They were founded in New York City in 1947 as Franklin Distributors, Inc. In 1992 they merged with Templeton, Galbraith & Hansberger which had started in 1954 under John Templeton. The company’s stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol BEN, in honor of Benjamin Franklin, for whom the company is named, and who was admired by founder Rupert Johnson Sr. In 1973, the company's headqu

about: Oerlikon is a Swiss industrial technology group based in Pfaffikon, with two main divisions: Surface Solutions, which applies coatings to tools and automotive and aerospace parts, and Polymer Processing Solutions (Barmag), which makes equipment for man-made fibres. Customers are industrial manufacturers in aerospace, automotive, tooling and textiles in over 35 countries, with revenue of about CHF 2.4 billion. Listed on SIX Swiss Exchange (OERL). The name is historic but largely B2B, with little consumer awareness.

Sandisk is a leading US flash memory and storage brand, based in Milpitas, California, founded in 1988 and spun off from Western Digital in February 2025 as a separate company listed on Nasdaq (SNDK). It makes NAND flash memory, SSDs and consumer products such as SanDisk SD cards, USB drives and portable SSDs, sold through retailers and to data centre and device customers. Revenue is about $7 billion. Joint venture with Kioxia manufactures wafers in Japan. A very recognisable consumer storage brand worldwide.

wiki.title: Sandisk
wiki.text: Sandisk Corporation (formerly SunDisk Corporation and SanDisk Corporation) is an American multinational computer semiconductor company based in Milpitas, California. Founded in 1988, it designs and manufactures flash memory products, including memory cards, USB flash drives, and solid-state drives (SSDs).

about: Box is a Redwood City, California cloud content management company, founded in 2005 by Aaron Levie, that offers secure file sharing, collaboration, e-signature and AI-based content tools to large enterprises, governments and regulated industries. It listed on the NYSE (BOX) in 2015 and has annual revenue of about US$1.1 billion, with tens of thousands of customers. It is B2B but has a decent marketing profile in technology circles, with brand awareness among office workers and IT buyers.

wiki.title: Box
wiki.text: A box (plural: boxes) is a container with rigid sides used for the storage or transportation of its contents. Most boxes have flat, parallel, rectangular sides (typically rectangular prisms). Boxes can be very small (like a matchbox) or very large (like a shipping box for furniture) and can be used for a variety of purposes, from functional to decorative. Boxes may be made of a variety of materials, both durable (such as wood and metal) and non-durable (such as corrugated fiberboard and paperboard). Corrugated metal boxes are commonly used as shipping containers. Boxes may be closed and shut with flaps, doors, or a separate lid. They can be s

wiki.title: Box, Inc.
wiki.text: Box, Inc. (formerly Box.net) is an American public company based in Redwood City, California. It develops and markets cloud-based content management, collaboration, and file sharing tools for businesses. Box was founded in 2005 by Aaron Levie and Dylan Smith. Initially, it focused on consumers, but around 2009 and 2010 Box pivoted to focus on business users. The company raised about $500 million over numerous funding rounds before going public in 2015. Its software allows users to store and manage files in an online folder system accessible from any device. Users can then comment on the files, share them, apply workflows, and implement securi

about: Lazard is a New York financial advisory and asset management firm, listed on the NYSE (LAZ), advising companies and governments on mergers and acquisitions, restructuring and capital raising, and managing about US$250 billion of client assets. Founded in 1848, it is known as an independent investment bank with offices in Europe, Asia and the Americas, with revenue near US$3 billion. Funding of about $700M was recorded in 2025 per the data. B2B financial services brand, with an elite corporate profile but limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Lazard
wiki.text: Lazard Inc. (formerly known as Lazard Ltd and Lazard Frères & Co.) is a multinational financial advisory and asset management firm that is headquartered in the United States. The firm engages in investment banking, asset management and other financial services, primarily with institutional clients. It is the world's largest independent investment bank, with principal executive offices in New York City, Paris and London. Lazard was founded in 1848 and operates from 41 cities across 26 countries in North America, Europe, Asia, Australia, and Central and South America. The firm provides advice on mergers and acquisitions, strategic matters, rest

about: Collinson Group is a London-based customer loyalty and travel services business that runs airport lounge access through Priority Pass, plus travel insurance, flight-delay compensation, digital rewards and loyalty programmes for banks, airlines and card issuers. Customers are mainly financial institutions and travel brands that bundle benefits for their cardholders; consumers use Priority Pass lounges in over 150 countries. It is privately owned, and Crunchbase shows about 350 million of investment in September 2026. Priority Pass is a well-known premium traveller brand with an affluent audience.

Xreal is a Beijing-based maker of augmented reality glasses, formerly Nreal, selling consumer AR display glasses such as Xreal Air, Air 2 and One that plug into phones, laptops and consoles to show a large virtual screen, as well as the Beam accessory. Customers are consumers, gamers and travellers, and revenue is from hardware sales in Asia, North America and Europe. Founded in 2017, it has raised about $450 million from investors including Alibaba and iQiyi. Growing consumer tech brand with a strong online presence.

Johnson Controls International is a global building technology company that makes and services HVAC, fire and security systems, building automation and controls under brands such as York, Tyco, Metasys and Simplex. It is legally based in Cork, Ireland, with operational headquarters in Milwaukee, and is listed on the NYSE (JCI). Revenue is about 23 billion dollars and employees about 100,000. Customers are commercial, industrial and public buildings. Prominent B2B name with some stadium naming partnerships.

wiki.title: Johnson Controls
wiki.what: Building systems and facility management firm based in Cork, Ireland
wiki.text: Johnson Controls International plc is an American multinational conglomerate headquartered in Cork, Ireland, that produces fire, HVAC, and security equipment for buildings. As of mid-2019, it employed 105,000 people in around 2,000 locations across six continents. In 2017 it was listed as 389th in the Fortune Global 500. It became ineligible for the Fortune 500 in subsequent years since it relocated its headquarters outside the U.S. The company was formed via the merger of American company Johnson Controls with Tyco International, announced on 25 January 2016. The merger led to the avoidance of taxation on foreign market operations and a fina

about: Kiteworks is a San Mateo, California cybersecurity company offering a private content network that protects sensitive files, email and data exchange for regulated enterprises such as banks, healthcare and government. Previously Accellion, it rebranded in 2021 and is backed by Insight Partners and Vector Capital. Customers are large enterprises and governments paying subscriptions. Raised about 592 million dollars. B2B security vendor with little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Kiteworks
wiki.text: Kiteworks, formerly known as Accellion, Inc., is an American technology company that secures sensitive content communications over channels such as email, file share, file transfer, managed file transfer, web forms, and application programming interfaces. It was founded in 1999 in Singapore and is now based in San Mateo, California. The Kiteworks Private Data Network consolidates file and email data communications onto a single platform, enabling organizations to reduce data privacy exposure risk and demonstrate conformance with a variety of data privacy regulations.

about: Rockwell Automation is a Milwaukee-based maker of industrial automation and digital transformation technology, including Allen-Bradley control systems, FactoryTalk software, drives, motors and safety products, plus software like Plex and Fiix. Listed on the NYSE (ROK), with revenue near 8 billion dollars and about 29,000 employees. Customers are manufacturers across automotive, food, life sciences and energy. Funding of 500 million dollars. B2B brand, long associated with motorsport sponsorship.

wiki.title: Rockwell Automation
wiki.text: Rockwell Automation, Inc. is an American provider of industrial automation and digital transformation technologies headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Its brands include Allen-Bradley, FactoryTalk software and LifecycleIQ Services. Rockwell Automation employs approximately 27,000 people and has customers in more than 100 countries worldwide.

about: Persona is a San Francisco identity verification platform that helps businesses confirm user identities, prevent fraud and meet compliance with KYC and AML checks using IDs, selfies and database lookups. Customers include fintechs, marketplaces and large consumer apps. Founded in 2019, it has raised about 417 million dollars including a 2025 round at a valuation of about 2 billion dollars. B2B software with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Persona
wiki.text: A persona (plural personae or personas) is a strategic mask of identity in public, the public image of one's personality, the social role that one adopts, or simply a fictional character. It is also considered "an intermediary between the individual and the institution." Persona studies is an academic field developed by communication and media scholars. The related notions of "impression management" and "presentation of self" have been discussed by Erving Goffman in the 1950s. The word persona derives from Latin, where it originally referred to a theatrical mask. The usage of the word dates back to the beginnings of Latin civilization. The La

about: Global IT infrastructure services provider spun off from IBM in November 2021, running data centres, cloud migration, mainframe, network and cybersecurity services for large enterprises and governments in about 60 countries. Based in New York City and listed on the NYSE (KD), it has roughly 80,000 employees and annual revenue of about 16 billion dollars. Customers include many Fortune 500 firms and banks, with contracts typically multi-year. B2B with low consumer awareness, though it markets its corporate brand broadly.

wiki.title: Kyndryl
wiki.text: Kyndryl Holdings, Inc. is an American multinational corporation headquartered in New York City. The company designs, builds, and manages infrastructure services. The company also has business advisory services.

about: Turkey-based home appliance brand, Beko, owned by Arçelik and the Koç Holding group, selling washing machines, fridges, ovens and small appliances in more than 100 countries, and number one in white goods in Europe. Arçelik merged its European operations with Whirlpool's EMEA business in 2024. Sells through retailers to households. Strong consumer brand across Europe, with a sponsorship history including football (FC Barcelona), basketball and tennis.

wiki.title: Beko
wiki.text: Beko ( BEK-oh) is a Turkish white goods and electronics brand of Arçelik A.Ş., which is controlled by the Koç Holding conglomerate.

about: Pop Mart is a Beijing-based designer and retailer of collectible toys, listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (9992), known for blind-box figures such as Molly, Skullpanda, Dimoo and Labubu from Kasing Lung's The Monsters, which became a global fashion phenomenon in 2025. It sells via thousands of robo-shops and stores in China and more than 20 other countries, plus apps and online platforms, and runs the Beijing theme park Pop Land. Revenue is above 10 billion yuan and growing fast. Founded in 2010 by Wang Ning. Very strong consumer brand with young fans worldwide.

wiki.title: Pop Mart
wiki.text: Pop Mart (Chinese: 泡泡玛特; pinyin: Pào pào mǎ tè) is a Chinese toy company based in Beijing. The company is known for selling collectible toys and figurines in a "blind box" format. The company produces toys based on its in-house IPs, such as Labubu, as well as licensed themes, such as Disney, Teletubbies, The Powerpuff Girls, Care Bears and Harry Potter. The Financial Times described the company as having "elevated toy-buying to an act of trendy connoisseurship among China's young affluent consumers", and as having been "credited with creating the market for so-called designer toys". Around half of its sales are made at physical outlets, with

about: DevSecOps platform sold as software that covers the whole software lifecycle in one application, from source code hosting and issue tracking to CI/CD pipelines, security scanning and deployment, offered as a SaaS product or self-managed. Customers are software teams at enterprises and startups, paying per-seat subscription tiers, with well over 30 million registered users and customers such as Goldman Sachs and Siemens. Founded by Sid Sijbrandij and Dmitriy Zaporozhets, it operates as a remote-first company and listed on Nasdaq (GTLB) in 2021. Strong brand among developers, but little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: GitLab
wiki.text: GitLab is a software forge primarily developed by GitLab Inc. It is available as either a free software "Community" edition or a proprietary software "Enterprise" edition.

about: Vietnamese subsidiary of VinFast, the electric vehicle maker founded by Vingroup, producing the VF series electric SUVs, e-scooters and buses at its factory in Hai Phong, and selling in Vietnam and increasingly the United States and Europe. VinFast Auto is listed on Nasdaq (VFS) after a SPAC merger in 2023, and Vingroup chairman Pham Nhat Vuong is the main shareholder. Customers are drivers and fleet buyers. High brand awareness in Vietnam with heavy marketing and football sponsorship.

US consumer and specialty products maker behind Arm & Hammer baking soda, laundry detergent and cat litter, OxiClean, Trojan condoms, First Response pregnancy tests, Waterpik, Batiste dry shampoo, Spinbrush, Zicam, Vitafusion gummies and Hero acne patches, plus a specialty products unit. Sells mainly through mass retailers and online, with annual revenue around $6bn. Founded in 1846 and listed on the NYSE (CHD). Household brands in North America with growing international sales; sponsorship has historically been through individual brands.

wiki.title: Church & Dwight
wiki.text: Church & Dwight Co., Inc. is an American consumer packaged goods company headquartered in Ewing Township, New Jersey. It manufactures and markets household, personal-care and specialty products in the United States and internationally. The company is best known for Arm & Hammer, whose baking soda and related products trace their origins to a business established by John Dwight and Austin Church in 1846. As of 2026, other major brands include Trojan, OxiClean, Nair, First Response, Orajel, Waterpik, Batiste, TheraBreath, Hero Cosmetics and Touchland. Church & Dwight operates through three business segments: Consumer Domestic, Consumer Internat

about: Garbled entry whose description reads Gruppo Campari: the Milan-based spirits group behind Campari, Aperol, Wild Turkey, Grand Marnier, SKYY, Espolon, Appleton Estate, Cinzano and Crodino, among about fifty global and regional brands. Sells to consumers through retailers, bars and travel retail in more than 190 countries, with annual sales of roughly 3 billion euros. Listed on Borsa Italiana (CPR) and controlled by the Garavoglia family. Aperol Spritz and Campari are very strong consumer brands, with a strong history of sports and events marketing.
flags: name read with low OCR confidence: check spelling

wiki.title: Campari Group
wiki.text: Davide Campari-Milano N.V., trading as Campari Group, is an Italian company active since 1860 in the branded beverage industry. It produces spirits, wines, and non-alcoholic apéritifs. From its signature product, Campari, its portfolio has been extended to include over 50 brands, including Aperol, Appleton, Picon, SKYY vodka, Espolón, Wild Turkey, Grand Marnier, and Forty Creek whisky.

about: Indian IT services group headquartered in Noida, founded in 1976 by Shiv Nadar. It sells software engineering, cloud, cybersecurity, digital and engineering services and its own products to large enterprises worldwide, mainly in the US and Europe, with roughly 220,000 employees in 60 countries and annual revenue of about $13 billion. Listed on NSE and BSE. B2B brand with growing global profile through sports and sponsorship deals.
flags: last funding 2008: check it is still independent and operating

wiki.title: HCLTech
wiki.text: HCL Technologies Limited (HCLTech) is an Indian multinational technology company headquartered in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. It was spun out of HCL Group in 1991 when HCL entered into the software services business. Founded by Shiv Nadar, the company maintains a presence in 60 countries, while it employs over 230,000 individuals. Additionally, it is the third-largest India-headquartered IT services company by revenue and market capitalization. The company unveiled its brand identity "HCLTech", underpinned by the distinct positioning of Supercharging Progress™, in 2022. In 2025, HCLTech was named the highest-ranked India-headquartered technology co

about: Paris advertising technology firm (Criteo) offering retargeting and commerce media to advertisers and publishers. It uses shopper data and AI to serve product ads across the open internet, with retailers, brands and agencies as customers and revenue largely from a share of ad spend. Operates in dozens of countries with thousands of staff. Listed on Nasdaq as CRTO. B2B with agency brand awareness.
flags: listed (IPO status: public); last funding 2013: check it is still independent and operating

wiki.title: Criteo
wiki.text: Criteo S.A. is an advertising company that provides online display advertisements. The company was founded and is headquartered in Paris, France.

about: California cybersecurity vendor (Palo Alto Networks) selling firewalls, cloud security and AI-driven security platforms to enterprises and governments globally, with tens of thousands of customers and annual revenue of about $9 billion. Platforms include Prisma Cloud, Cortex and Prisma Access, plus acquisitions such as CyberArk. Founded in 2005. Nasdaq listed as PANW. B2B with strong tech brand awareness.
flags: listed (IPO status: public); last funding 2008: check it is still independent and operating

wiki.title: Palo Alto Networks
wiki.text: Palo Alto Networks, Inc. is an American multinational cybersecurity company with headquarters in Santa Clara, California. The core product is a platform that includes advanced firewalls and cloud-based offerings that extend those firewalls to cover other aspects of security. The company serves over 70,000 organizations in over 150 countries, including 85 of the Fortune 100. It is home to the Unit 42 threat research team and hosts the Ignite cybersecurity conference. It is a partner organization of the World Economic Forum. In June 2018, former Google and SoftBank executive Nikesh Arora joined the company as Chairman and CEO.
